card.name: Words just before fit of devices
card.fires_on: Words in a passage about fitted devices (goggles, dentures, hearing aids, lenses) where the next word is likely 'fit' or 'fitting'. It also fires on the word 'fitting' itself in 'poorly fitting dentures'.

modes.label: Linking word before fit
modes.description: Small words like since, properly, the or of in text about how eyewear or aids fit.
modes.example: Sport goggles must be<< properly>> fit to the individual wearer.

modes.label: Poorly fitting dentures
modes.description: The word fitting or part of it inside 'poorly fitting' or 'ill-fitting' dentures in risk lists.
modes.example: local trauma including poorly<< fitting>> dentures

modes.label: Hearing aid and device text
modes.description: Punctuation or small words before or after hearing aids and listening devices, where fitting is expected.
